svg.title: Model diagram with sample-domain weights, MLP, weighted experts, loss, and pretraining domains
svg.desc: Full figure inventory and conduction notes: left origin is the sample-domain weight histogram and h-vector label, feeding rightward through a branching line into the Model frame and downward into the Pretraining domains frame. Model frame contains an MLP hexagon, three MLP output arrows to blue alpha-times labels and red expert blocks E1, ellipsis, En; yellow S block above feeds the central summation node; expert blocks feed the same summation node, which feeds orange Theta, then a vertical path to Loss. Lower frame contains Data label, four cylinder domain icons D1, D2, middle domain, Dk, an x sample path, and Sample data text. Section symmetry basis: model section is organized around the central sum circle with roughly vertical stacking of S/E1/ellipsis/En; pretraining section is horizontally equipartitioned by domain icons. Confirmed SAM mappings: S draft_S_block to asset_sam_region_000032; Theta draft_theta_block to asset_sam_region_000031; middle ellipsis expert draft_red_ellipsis_block to asset_sam_region_000033; En draft_En_block to asset_sam_region_000034; D1 draft_cyl_D1 to asset_sam_region_000030; D2 draft_cyl_D2 to asset_sam_region_000028; middle domain draft_cyl_Dmid to asset_sam_region_000029; Dk draft_cyl_Dk to asset_sam_region_000027. Outer true frames and uncovered text/arrows are retained.
